FAQ

Questions, answered

Do I need a gym membership?

No. Workouts are designed to be done from home, with bodyweight exercises, dumbbells or water bottles, resistance bands and other easily available household props.

Do I have to eat special or expensive foods?

No. Diet plans are practical and adjusted to your regular lifestyle and food preferences, without extreme restrictions.

Do I need to submit medical lab reports to join?

No. Sharing your diagnosis or relevant health conditions during the initial evaluation is enough to tailor your diet and guidance safely.

Can I join from another country?

Yes. Women from many countries join online, and prices are shown for your region.

Checkout

Test mode. Payments use Stripe's test environment, so no real money moves.
What happens next
  1. Pay securely on Stripe's checkout page.
  2. Get a welcome email with your onboarding form.
  3. Your coach builds your plan, and your dashboard opens.

By continuing you agree to the Terms of Service and the Refund, Cancellation & Freeze Policy.

In the real build this button creates a Stripe Checkout Session for at and redirects to Stripe's hosted page.

While the site is in test mode you can pay with Stripe's published test card 4242 4242 4242 4242, any future expiry date and any CVC. No real charge is made.

After payment, Stripe sends a webhook that creates the order and the membership, then the welcome email goes out.
